errors.evidence: Description reports 0.6992 for anomaly detection accuracy, but the figure shows 0.692.
The description omits the label for the right y-axis ('准确率'), though it mentions the axis and its range.
The description states there is no specific sorting rule, but the reference implies a logical order. This is an inference not explicitly supported by the figure.

errors.text_span: 图表的水平轴（X轴）按从左到右顺序排列五个任务类别，无特定排序规则；垂直轴（Y轴）为双轴结构，左侧主Y轴表示训练集与验证集数量，刻度范围从0到1200，单位为“数量”，刻度间隔为200；右侧副Y轴表示准确率，刻度范围从0到1，单位为“比率”，刻度间隔为0.1。
